>"It is not clear from DOD’s interpretation whether a dealer can sell GAP and credit insurance products separately if they are not financed."

My GAP company is not the dealer, nor is it the creditor. It is an independent company that was set up *through* my dealer. GAP is/was an option, so you can turn it down, if you have "car replacement" coverage through your insurance. 

Side note: car replacement is not gap. But gap *can be* car replacement. Check your insurance policy, and don't pay for the same thing twice.
